design_detail: ACOG Clinical Practice Guideline No. 4 (screening and diagnosis); a priori protocol, librarian literature search, modified GRADE evidence-to-decision framework
population: Pregnant and postpartum individuals with mental health conditions
sample_size_detail: Guideline; no study sample
rationale: PubMed type 'Practice Guideline'; ACOG CPG issuing graded recommendations and Good Practice Points.

design_detail: Diagnostic manual (DSM-5-TR), American Psychiatric Association, 2022
population: General (diagnostic criteria for mental disorders)
sample_size_detail: Diagnostic manual; no study sample
rationale: Citation is to the DSM-5-TR, a diagnostic manual, which the protocol lists under 'Not a study (resource)'.

design_detail: Descriptive screening/diagnostic study (self-described 'sequential case series'): telephone EPDS screening at 4-6 weeks postpartum, SCID home-visit diagnosis for EPDS>=10; single urban academic hospital (Pittsburgh)
severity_measure: Descriptive prevalence study; no treatment/exposure-outcome comparison (only chi-square comparisons of demographics by screen status)
comparison_group: None (screen-positive vs screen-negative women compared descriptively)
population: Postpartum women (>=18 y, English-speaking) delivering at Magee-Womens Hospital, Pittsburgh, screened at 4-6 weeks postpartum
sample_size_detail: 17,601 approached; 17,426 eligible; 10,000 screened; 1,396 screen-positive; 826 SCID home visits; 147 telephone MDD interviews
rationale: Purely descriptive screening yield, onset timing, and diagnosis distribution; no comparative effect estimate. Authors call it a case series, but it is a population screening/prevalence analysis, so coded 5 (precedes case series in the decision order).

design_detail: Web page of the Alliance for Innovation on Maternal Health (saferbirth.org) on perinatal mental health conditions; content not in file
population: Perinatal patients (maternal safety initiative)
sample_size_detail: Website; no study sample
rationale: Citation-only website (accessed 2023). The file has no content; it may be a consensus safety bundle (would be Guideline), but only a web resource can be confirmed.

design_detail: Narrative clinical review of epidemiology, genetics, triggers, diagnosis, treatment and prevention of postpartum psychosis
population: Women with postpartum psychosis/mania
sample_size_detail: Narrative review; no pooled sample
rationale: PubMed type 'Review'; authors 'reviewed' research and 'synthesized the sparse clinical studies' with no systematic search or pooling described.

design_detail: USPSTF recommendation statement (B recommendation) on depression screening in adults, based on systematic evidence review
population: Adults >=18 y, including older adults and pregnant and postpartum women
sample_size_detail: Recommendation statement; no study sample
rationale: PubMed type 'Practice Guideline'; USPSTF recommendation statement.

design_detail: American Academy of Pediatrics committee report with clinical and advocacy recommendations on perinatal depression recognition and management in pediatric practice
population: Mothers with perinatal depression and their infants seen in pediatric medical homes
sample_size_detail: Committee report; no study sample
rationale: Authored by an AAP committee and gives recommendations (e.g., PPD screening at 1-, 2-, 4-, 6-month visits). PubMed tags it 'Review', so Narrative review is an alternative code.

design_detail: American College of Nurse-Midwives position statement on mental health during childbirth and across the lifespan
population: Childbearing people and women across the lifespan
sample_size_detail: Position statement; no study sample
rationale: The citation itself labels it a 'Position statement', which the protocol lists under code 12.

design_detail: Website of the National Curriculum in Reproductive Psychiatry (training program)
population: Clinicians/trainees in reproductive psychiatry
sample_size_detail: Training resource; no study sample
rationale: Citation is to a training curriculum website, which the protocol lists under 'Not a study (resource)'.

design_detail: Pooled analysis of published maternal plasma, breast-milk and infant plasma antidepressant levels from 57 studies found by systematic electronic and bibliographic searches (1966-2002)
comparison_group: None (infant:maternal plasma ratios; correlations with maternal dose/levels)
population: Breastfeeding mothers taking antidepressants and their nursing infants
sample_size_detail: 67 relevant studies identified, 57 included; number of mother-infant pairs not reported in abstract
rationale: A systematic search plus pooled analysis of multiple studies goes to code 7 under the decision order, ahead of PK code 8. Component studies are drug-level reports and case reports.

design_detail: Self-described narrative review and commentary on US suicide disparities, illustrated with descriptive CDC WONDER mortality data (1999-2019)
population: US population (suicide deaths)
sample_size_detail: Narrative review; descriptive public data only
rationale: Authors state it is 'not a systematic review'; it is part narrative review and part commentary.

design_detail: Meta-analysis of double-blind placebo-controlled antidepressant relapse-prevention RCTs identified by systematic search (RevMan odds ratios)
population: Patients with depressive disorders who responded to acute antidepressant treatment
sample_size_detail: 54 placebo-controlled relapse-prevention studies; patient n = 9268
rationale: PubMed type 'Meta-Analysis'; pools 54 double-blind placebo-controlled trials.

design_detail: Prospective cohort (137 obstetric practices/clinics, Connecticut and western Massachusetts, 2005-2009), subgroup with prior depression; Cox regression with 2-month-lagged time-dependent antidepressant exposure; CIDI-defined MDE
severity_measure: Number of prior depressive episodes (1/2/3/4+), age at first episode, number of prior hospitalizations for depression, MDE in 6 months before pregnancy
comparison_group: Women with a history of depression not using antidepressants (time-varying exposure)
population: Pregnant women >=18 y with a history of depressive disorder, followed through 2 months postpartum, Connecticut and western Massachusetts, 2005-2009
sample_size_detail: Analytic sample 778 of 2,793 interviewed; 617 completed both follow-up interviews; 130 used antidepressants; 123 developed an MDE
rationale: Adjusted Cox model includes severity correlates the authors name as markers of 'severe depressive illness' (prior episodes, early onset, psychiatric hospitalization).

design_detail: Systematic review (PRISMA) and random-effects meta-analysis of psychotherapy (CBT, IPT) vs conventional obstetric care for antenatal depression, anxiety and quality of life
population: Pregnant women in the antenatal period
sample_size_detail: 17 RCTs + 5 controlled clinical trials; 1,180 psychotherapy vs 966 control; depression meta-analysis 803 vs 729 (14 studies)
rationale: Includes 17 RCTs and 5 non-randomized controlled clinical trials, so component designs are Mixed.

design_detail: Joint APA-ACOG work-group consensus report: non-systematic review of Medline/bibliography literature with management algorithms for depression before and during pregnancy
population: Pregnant women and women planning pregnancy with depression
sample_size_detail: Consensus report; no study sample
rationale: Joint report of two professional societies with consensus-derived management algorithms. PubMed tags it 'Review', so Narrative review is an alternative code.

design_detail: Lifeline for Moms Perinatal Mental Health Toolkit (UMass Medical School, 2019); clinical toolkit; source for ACOG Figures 1-2
population: Perinatal patients / perinatal care clinicians
sample_size_detail: Toolkit; no study sample
rationale: Citation is to a clinical toolkit web resource, not a study.

design_detail: Cochrane systematic review and meta-analysis of RCTs of TCAs or SSRIs vs placebo for depression in primary care
population: Adults <65 y with depression recruited in primary care
sample_size_detail: 14 studies (16 comparisons); 1,364 intervention vs 919 placebo
rationale: Cochrane review restricted to RCTs; pooled N computed from the abstract's intervention and placebo counts.

design_detail: Rationale-and-design article for a pharmacokinetic investigation to optimize SSRI dosing in pregnant women with depression
population: Pregnant women with depression treated with SSRIs
sample_size_detail: Design paper; no results
rationale: Title and abstract describe rationale and design only; no results reported.

design_detail: Retrospective cohort, Quebec health administrative databases (1998-2002); log-binomial regression of miscarriage corrected for induced abortion; multiple comparison groups
severity_measure: Multivariable adjustment reported but covariates not listed in abstract; depressed comparison group defined by prior depression diagnosis only
comparison_group: Unexposed non-depressed women; unexposed women with prior depression diagnosis; women using hypothyroid medication
population: Pregnant women in Quebec health administrative databases, 1998-2002
sample_size_detail: Total cohort 41,964; exposure-group sizes not given in abstract
rationale: Adjusted comparison of first-trimester antidepressant users (with depression) vs several unexposed groups. Severity adjustment can't be checked from the abstract, so it is coded 4 by default.

design_detail: Systematic review and random-effects meta-analysis (MOOSE) of cohort and case-control studies of prenatal antidepressant (SSRI) exposure and persistent pulmonary hypertension of the newborn
comparison_group: Infants of pregnant women unexposed to the antidepressant
population: Pregnant women and their newborns
sample_size_detail: 5 cohort and 2 case-control studies; total pooled participants not reported
rationale: Inclusion limited to cohort and case-control studies; 7 studies pooled.

design_detail: Systematic review and random-effects meta-analysis of cohort and case-control studies of maternal SSRI use and PPHN
comparison_group: Infants of mothers not using SSRIs in pregnancy
population: Pregnant women and their newborns
sample_size_detail: 9 cohort/case-control studies reviewed (8 meta-analyzed); 7,540,265 subjects
rationale: PubMed type 'Meta-Analysis'; includes only cohort and case-control studies.

design_detail: Secondary analysis of 2 NIMH prospective observational cohorts (Cleveland and Pittsburgh, 2000-2011); blinded Finnegan Scale exam at 2-4 weeks; chi-square/Kruskal-Wallis across 3 groups, plus a supplementary logistic model (results not shown)
severity_measure: Groups defined by mood-disorder diagnosis; supplementary model adjusted only for preterm birth, maternal race and age; SIGH-ADS scores compared descriptively, not modeled
comparison_group: Untreated women with mood disorder (MDD/bipolar); healthy unexposed women without mood disorder
population: Pregnant women with MDD or bipolar disorder (SRI-treated or untreated) and healthy comparison women, Cleveland and Pittsburgh, 2000-2011, and their infants
sample_size_detail: 41 SRI-exposed, 94 untreated mood disorder, 79 comparison
rationale: Primary results are crude rates of Finnegan signs by group. A supplementary logistic model (preterm, race, age; results not shown) would make it code 4, and still without severity.

design_detail: Systematic review and meta-analysis of cohort and case-control studies of prenatal antidepressant exposure and poor neonatal adaptation syndrome
comparison_group: Infants not exposed to antidepressants in utero
population: Pregnant women and their newborns
sample_size_detail: 12 studies included; pooled participants not reported in abstract
rationale: Selection limited to cohort and case-control studies; 12 included.

design_detail: Systematic literature review (MEDLINE, PsycINFO, unpublished FDA data) of neonatal signs after late-pregnancy SRI exposure; Mantel-Haenszel summary risk ratio from cohort studies plus synthesis of case reports
comparison_group: Neonates with early gestational or no SRI exposure
population: Neonates exposed to SRIs in the last trimester through delivery
sample_size_detail: 13 case reports (18 cases) + 9 cohort studies; pooled participant total not reported
rationale: Titled 'literature review', but it uses a systematic search, inclusion criteria and pooled Mantel-Haenszel RRs, so coded 7. Components are case reports and cohort studies.

design_detail: Register-based cohort, Swedish Medical Birth Register; infants of mothers reporting benzodiazepine/hypnotic BZRA use in early pregnancy (or prescribed in late pregnancy) compared with all births; adjusted ORs
severity_measure: Adjusted OR reported but covariates not listed in abstract; reference group is all births (no restriction by indication)
comparison_group: All births in the Swedish Medical Birth Register
population: Infants born in Sweden recorded in the Medical Birth Register; mothers reporting benzodiazepine/BZRA use
sample_size_detail: 1,979 infants (1,944 mothers) exposed in early pregnancy; 401 infants (390 mothers) exposed in late pregnancy; reference = all births n=873,879
rationale: Adjusted register comparison of exposed infants vs all births; covariates not given in the abstract, so severity is Unclear and type defaults to 4. N is the reference population, which the abstract treats as the analytic frame.

design_detail: ACOG Practice Bulletin No. 187 on neural tube defects (prevention, screening, management recommendations)
population: Pregnancies at risk of or complicated by fetal neural tube defects
sample_size_detail: Practice bulletin; no study sample
rationale: PubMed type 'Practice Guideline'; ACOG Practice Bulletin making management recommendations.

design_detail: Narrative review (Current Opinion) of animal and clinical evidence on high-dose folic acid for prevention of congenital heart defects
population: Women planning pregnancy / early pregnancy, especially with family history of CHD
sample_size_detail: Narrative review; no pooled sample
rationale: PubMed type 'Review'; 'Purpose of Review' format with no systematic methods.

design_detail: Pooled reanalysis of individual data from five prospective European studies of antiepileptic drug exposure in pregnancy (major congenital malformations)
severity_measure: Pooled multi-study analysis (code 7); comparisons with matched nonepileptic controls and between AED regimens/doses; covariates not described in abstract
comparison_group: Children of matched nonepileptic control pregnancies; also between AED regimens and valproate dose levels
population: Children of women with epilepsy (AED-exposed) and unexposed controls in five prospective European cohorts
sample_size_detail: 1,221 AED-exposed and 158 unexposed control children; headline RR compares 192 exposed vs 158 matched nonepileptic controls
rationale: Pooled reanalysis of five prospective studies, which the protocol places under 'pooled/IPD analysis of multiple studies'. PubMed also tags it 'Meta-Analysis'.

design_detail: Prospective pharmacokinetic study of carbamazepine and its 10,11-epoxide/diol metabolites in maternal serum, urine and amniotic fluid in early pregnancy; relation to dose, comedication and pregnancy outcome
comparison_group: None (comparisons by dose, comedication, and normal vs malformed outcome)
population: Pregnant women with epilepsy exposed to carbamazepine in the first trimester, referred before 16 weeks for prenatal diagnosis
sample_size_detail: 100 pregnancies with first-trimester CBZ exposure (7 with malformed outcome)
rationale: Main analyses are drug and metabolite concentrations by dose and comedication; outcome comparison is crude and unadjusted.

design_detail: Single case report of a neonate with fatal cardiac malformation attributed to maternal valproate (fetal valproate syndrome)
population: Neonate exposed to valproate in utero
sample_size_detail: One neonate
rationale: PubMed type 'Case Reports'; one neonate described.

design_detail: Clinical case series of children exposed to valproic acid in utero evaluated for fetal valproate syndrome phenotype (monotherapy vs polytherapy described)
comparison_group: None (descriptive contrast of VPA monotherapy vs VPA plus other anticonvulsants)
population: Children exposed to valproic acid in utero
sample_size_detail: 19 VPA-exposed children evaluated
rationale: PubMed type 'Case Reports'; 19 exposed children described with no unexposed comparison group.

design_detail: Case series of VPA-exposed infants from the Spanish Collaborative Study of Congenital Malformations (ECEMC), 1976-1988, with review of published cases and epidemiologic data
comparison_group: None (descriptive contrast of VPA monotherapy vs VPA plus other anticonvulsants)
population: Infants prenatally exposed to valproic acid, Spain
sample_size_detail: 28 exposed cases (15 VPA monotherapy, 13 VPA + other AEDs)
rationale: Describes 28 exposed patients' manifestations without an unexposed comparison group, alongside a literature review.

design_detail: Letter/comment reporting case(s) of fetal valproate syndrome with autism (no abstract available)
population: Child(ren) with fetal valproate syndrome and autism
sample_size_detail: Number of cases not available (no abstract)
rationale: PubMed types 'Case Reports; Comment; Letter'. No abstract, so content and number of cases can't be checked.

design_detail: Case series of patients with fetal valproate syndrome and autism
population: Children with fetal valproate syndrome and autism
sample_size_detail: Five additional patients (one previously reported patient not counted)
rationale: Presents 'five additional patients with FVS and autism' with no comparison group.

design_detail: Retrospective postal questionnaire survey of women with epilepsy (Mersey Regional Epilepsy Clinic, UK) about pregnancies and children's schooling; odds ratios of additional educational needs by in-utero AED exposure
severity_measure: Abstract reports ORs but never says whether they are adjusted (Amendment 1b); epilepsy severity (seizure type/frequency) not mentioned
comparison_group: School-age children of mothers with epilepsy not exposed to AEDs in utero
population: Children aged 4-18 of women aged 16-40 with epilepsy registered at the Mersey Regional Epilepsy Clinic, UK
sample_size_detail: 1,267 women approached, 721 responded, 330 with live-born children; 594 children total; 400 school-age (150 monotherapy, 74 polytherapy, 176 unexposed)
rationale: Comparative ORs of educational needs by exposure from survey data. Adjustment status isn't stated in the abstract, so under Amendment 1(b) this is coded 5 with severity Unclear and Low confidence.

design_detail: Narrative review of valproic acid teratogenicity and counseling of women of reproductive age in psychiatric practice
population: Women of reproductive age treated with valproic acid, including pregnant women
sample_size_detail: Narrative review; no pooled sample
rationale: PubMed type 'Review'; clinical overview with recommendations and no systematic methods.

design_detail: Prospective descriptive cohort of term infants exposed in utero to valproate: incidence of hypoglycaemia and withdrawal symptoms, correlations with maternal valproate dose and plasma levels
severity_measure: No comparison group described in abstract; correlations with maternal valproate dose/levels only
population: Term infants of women with epilepsy treated with valproate during pregnancy
sample_size_detail: 22 infants (20 valproate monotherapy, 2 valproate + carbamazepine); 13 hypoglycaemic; 10 with withdrawal symptoms
rationale: Exposure-defined prospective study reporting outcome incidence with no comparison group described. Could also be coded case series, or PK for the drug-level correlations.

design_detail: Review of published reports (MEDLINE/PubMed, EMBASE, Scopus, Cochrane Library, any language since 1996) of gestational diabetes with second-generation antipsychotic exposure in pregnancy; no meta-analysis
comparison_group: None (case reports and retrospective/prospective studies summarized)
population: Pregnant women exposed to second-generation antipsychotics
sample_size_detail: Number of included studies not stated; 18 GDM cases summarized
rationale: Lists databases and inclusion rules ('all articles reporting metabolic complications'), suggesting a systematic search. But it is an Expert Opinion 'Review' with no meta-analysis, so Narrative review is a plausible alternative.

design_detail: Retrospective cohort nested in US Medicaid Analytic eXtract 2000-2007; logistic regression; primary analysis restricted to women with depression with propensity-score stratification (100 strata); hdPS confirmatory analysis
severity_measure: Number of outpatient and inpatient depression diagnoses (proxies for depression severity), plus other psychotropic medications and other indications in the propensity score
comparison_group: Pregnant women with depression not exposed to antidepressants in the first trimester (fully adjusted); all unexposed women (unadjusted)
population: Medicaid-enrolled pregnant women with live-born infants, 46 US states + DC, 2000-2007
sample_size_detail: Cohort 949,504 (64,389 AD-exposed, 46,144 SSRI; 885,115 unexposed); fully adjusted depression-restricted SSRI analysis: 36,778 SSRI vs 180,564 unexposed
rationale: The PS includes 'proxies for depression severity (number of outpatient and inpatient depression diagnoses)' within a depression-restricted cohort.

design_detail: Retrospective cohort in US Medicaid Analytic eXtract 2000-2007 restricted to women with depression; GEE relative risks with covariate adjustment; hdPS, active-comparator and continuer/discontinuer analyses
severity_measure: Number of outpatient (0,1,2-4,5-9,>=10) and inpatient (0,1,>=2) depression diagnoses; also other psychotropics, other indications, healthcare utilization
comparison_group: Pregnant women with depression and no antidepressant dispensing (also SSRI monotherapy as active comparator)
population: Medicaid-enrolled pregnant women with a depression diagnosis and live births, US, 2000-2007
sample_size_detail: 100,942 with depression; primary analysis excludes 15,175 with first-trimester-only use, leaving 85,767 (59,219 unexposed; 19,000 SSRI; 1,216 SNRI; 441 TCA; 2,622 bupropion; 647 other; 2,622 polytherapy)
rationale: Fully adjusted models include 'proxies of depression severity' (counts of outpatient/inpatient depression diagnoses) in a depression-restricted cohort.

design_detail: Population-based prospective birth cohort using Finnish national registers (singleton live births 1996-2010); SSRI-exposed vs psychiatric-diagnosis unexposed vs unexposed pregnancies; odds ratios (adjustment status not stated in abstract)
severity_measure: Abstract reports ORs but never says whether they are adjusted (Amendment 1b); comparison group with psychiatric diagnoses is defined by diagnosis only
comparison_group: Pregnancies unexposed to SSRIs but with psychiatric diagnoses; pregnancies unexposed to medications and psychiatric diagnoses
population: Singleton live births in Finland, 1996-2010
sample_size_detail: Sampling frame 845,345 offspring; SSRI-exposed 15,729; psychiatric-diagnosis unexposed 9,652; unexposed 31,394
rationale: Register cohort that addresses indication through a diagnosis-based comparison group. The abstract never says whether the ORs are adjusted, so Amendment 1(b) applies: coded 5, severity Unclear, Low confidence.

design_detail: Systematic review with random-effects meta-analysis of neonatal outcomes / poor neonatal adaptation after in utero SRI antidepressant exposure
comparison_group: Unexposed infants (often of mothers with depression)
population: Neonates exposed in utero to SRI antidepressants
sample_size_detail: 33 studies (69 outcomes); 17 outcomes meta-analyzed; pooled participants not reported in abstract
rationale: PubMed type 'Systematic Review; Meta-Analysis'. The abstract doesn't state component designs, although comparisons with unexposed infants imply observational studies.
